headline.purpose: Mobile route identity and compact high-emphasis headings.

caption.purpose: Tertiary metadata, never critical state by itself.

shadows.name: flat
shadows.purpose: Primary buttons and minimal light-mode separation.

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Standard cards and toolbars in light mode.

shadows.name: hover
shadows.purpose: Intentional lifted states in light mode.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Shells, dialogs, and overlays in light mode.

motion.name: ease-enter
motion.purpose: Entrances, hover lift, color changes, and width transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The solid indigo action used for explicit forward operations.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--color-primary); color: #fff; box-shadow: var(--shadow-flat); font: 600 16px var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 100ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-focus); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.75; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: The compact reusable search control for dense operational lists.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"></circle><path d="m21 21-4.3-4.3"></path></svg><input type="search" placeholder="Cari data" aria-label="Cari"></label>
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; display: block; width: 280px; } .ds-search svg { position: absolute; left: 12px; top: 50%; width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: var(--color-text-subtle); stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; transform: translateY(-50%); } .ds-search input { width: 100%; min-height: 38px; padding: 8px 38px 8px 34px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 9px; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-text); font: 400 14px var(--font-sans); outline: none; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--color-text-subtle); } .ds-search input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--color-primary); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-focus); } .ds-search input:disabled { background: var(--color-bg-subtle); color: var(--color-text-subtle); cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: The current sidebar destination with icon, label, and explicit page state.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.7rem; padding: 0.78rem 0.95rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-primary-soft-strong); border-radius: 0.9rem; background: var(--color-primary-soft); color: var(--color-primary-hover); font: 700 0.86rem var(--font-sans); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-focus); } .ds-nav-item:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Assistant Scope Selector
components.description: The selected radio-like scope that starts a bounded deterministic check.
components.css: .ds-assistant-scope { width: 100%; min-height: 46px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 20%, var(--color-border)); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--color-primary-soft); color: var(--assistant-primary-text, #3730a3); font: 800 13px var(--font-sans); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-assistant-scope svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-assistant-scope:hover:not(:disabled) { color: var(--color-text); background: var(--color-surface); } .ds-assistant-scope:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-assistant-scope:disabled { cursor: wait; opacity: 0.62; }

components.name: Verified Status Chip
components.description: A written verification state paired with semantic green, never color alone.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-success-soft); color: var(--assistant-success-text, #166534); font: 800 11px/1.35 var(--font-sans); }

components.css: .ds-assistant-result { max-width: 920px; padding: 20px; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--color-bg-subtle); color: var(--color-text); font-family: var(--font-sans); } .ds-result-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-result-head h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-result-head span { padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-danger-soft); color: var(--assistant-danger-text, #b91c1c); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-assistant-result p { margin: 6px 0 0; color: var(--color-text-muted); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-assistant-result small { display: block; margin-top: 8px; color: var(--color-text-subtle); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-assistant-result dl { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px 20px; margin: 12px 0 0; } .ds-assistant-result dt { color: var(--color-text-subtle); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; } .ds-assistant-result dd { margin: 2px 0 0; color: var(--color-text); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Assistant Composer
components.description: The bounded-context field and explicit rule-run action.
components.css: .ds-assistant-composer { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 56px; padding: 7px 8px 7px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--color-surface); } .ds-assistant-composer:focus-within { border-color: var(--color-primary); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-focus); } .ds-assistant-composer input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-text); font: 400 16px var(--font-sans); } .ds-assistant-composer input::placeholder { color: var(--color-text-subtle); opacity: 1; } .ds-assistant-composer button { min-width: 46px; min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 11px; background: var(--color-primary); color: #fff; font: 800 13px var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; } .ds-assistant-composer button svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-assistant-composer button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-assistant-composer button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.45; }

narrative.overview:
The system feels like a calm, premium operations desk: warm neutral surfaces, compact evidence, and a restrained indigo signal that helps operators find the next action without turning the dashboard into a spectacle. Habil Smart-Assistant is its clearest expression—assistant-shaped, but visibly deterministic, read-only, and accountable to business evidence.

Apple-HIG influence appears through precise hierarchy, generous touch targets, softened geometry, quiet elevation, and responsive reflow. Density is intentional on desktop and simplified on mobile; decoration never competes with the reason, evidence, status, or destination behind an operational recommendation.
keyCharacteristics: Warm neutral surfaces with a single restrained indigo action voice.
Structured evidence before decoration: summary, reason, figures, then action.
Compact desktop density with opaque, touch-safe mobile reflow.
Light and dark themes preserve semantic hierarchy and readable status contrast.
Lucide line icons support labels; they do not replace operational language.

rules.name: The One Action Voice Rule
rules.body: Indigo owns selection, focus, and forward action; semantic colors communicate state and must not become competing calls to action.

rules.name: The Evidence Before Accent Rule
rules.body: Color may prioritize evidence, but severity must also remain legible through labels, icons, borders, or structure.

rules.name: The Operational Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Use weight and spacing before increasing size; large display type is reserved for route identity, not every card.

rules.name: The Numeric Trust Rule
rules.body: Operational figures use tabular numerals so evidence aligns and can be compared without visual jitter.

rules.name: The Evidence Lane Rule
rules.body: Recommendations keep title, severity, summary, reason, numeric evidence, and destination action in one scannable lane before secondary context is introduced.

rules.name: The Solid Surface Rule
rules.body: Glass and blur are not card materials; blur is limited to the mobile app-bar safety layer and transient overlay contexts.

rules.name: The Ambient Elevation Rule
rules.body: Shadows communicate containment or temporary lift, never ornament or hard-edged decoration.

rules.name: The Nested Radius Rule
rules.body: Inner controls use a smaller radius than the surface containing them, preserving visible hierarchy instead of rounding every layer equally.

dos: Do keep assistant capability copy explicit: rule-based, non-generative, read-only, and advisory.
Do pair every recommendation with a reason, numerical evidence, severity label, and owning-module action.
Do preserve 44px touch targets, visible keyboard focus, 16px mobile inputs, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use solid surfaces and restrained Indigo Wash to maintain trust in light and dark modes.
Do keep dense information scannable through tabular numerals, short labels, and consistent evidence order.
donts: Don't use generative-AI imagery, chat theatrics, or copy that implies unsupported intelligence.
Don't use semantic colors as decorative accents or rely on color alone to communicate severity.
Don't add glass cards, decorative gradients, or strong shadows inside the evidence lane.
Don't introduce content-bearing text below the `caption` role; the shipped 10px evidence and severity labels are implementation debt, not a system token.
Don't canonize unavailable font weights; the shipped 850/900 declarations are implementation debt, so use the loaded Inter weights from the normative type roles.
